signature.name: VTask.find
signature.type: {ι : Type u_1} -> {X : Type u_2} -> [TopologicalSpace X] -> {u : ι → Set X} -> {s : Set X} -> {p : Set X → Prop} -> (c : Set (ShrinkingLemma.PartialRefinement u s p)) -> (ne : c.Nonempty) -> (i : ι) -> ShrinkingLemma.PartialRefinement u s p

conventions.statement: When no member v of c has i ∈ carrier v, VTask.find c ne i returns ne.some, the nonempty witness of c.
conventions.note: This is a fallback to an arbitrary valid element, not a junk value outside the type.

facts.statement: ∀ {ι : Type*} {X : Type*} [TopologicalSpace X] {u : ι → Set X} {s : Set X} {p : Set X → Prop} (c : Set (ShrinkingLemma.PartialRefinement u s p)) (ne : c.Nonempty) (i : ι), VTask.find c ne i ∈ c

facts.statement: ∀ {ι : Type*} {X : Type*} [TopologicalSpace X] {u : ι → Set X} {s : Set X} {p : Set X → Prop} (c : Set (ShrinkingLemma.PartialRefinement u s p)) (ne : c.Nonempty) (i : ι), i ∈ (VTask.find c ne i).carrier ↔ i ∈ ShrinkingLemma.PartialRefinement.chainSupCarrier c

facts.statement: ∀ {ι : Type*} {X : Type*} [TopologicalSpace X] {u : ι → Set X} {s : Set X} {p : Set X → Prop} (c : Set (ShrinkingLemma.PartialRefinement u s p)) (hc : IsChain (· ≤ ·) c) (ne : c.Nonempty) {i : ι} {v : ShrinkingLemma.PartialRefinement u s p} (hv : v ∈ c) (hi : i ∈ v.carrier), VTask.find c ne i i = v i
